decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline scope lists only 'title suggested' (per client) and omits auto-metadata; R2 maker labels 'Automatic page title, description, site icon, and preview-image gathering' an 'addition'. R1 client: 'I don't just want the title suggested — I'd like it to pull in the page's description and its little icon (and ideally a preview image) automatically ... before I approve.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline diverged from REF-BM-02 (title-only); client requested the missing description/favicon/preview auto-collection as a precondition to approval — corrective, requesting missing parts of the reference requirement (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline omits read-later (only 'favoriting'); R2 maker adds 'A read-later workflow with to-read and read states; new bookmarks default to to-read' as an addition. R1 client: 'A "read later" idea... mark a bookmark as unread/to-read and be able to look at just those, then mark them done... Right now I only see favorites, which isn't the same thing.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later (mark unread, view unread-only, mark read) was absent from the baseline; client explicitly requested it, distinguishing it from favorites — corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline omits archiving; R2 maker adds 'Archiving, a separate archive view, restoration, and permanent deletion.' R1 client: 'Archiving separate from deleting... tuck a bookmark away so it's out of my main list but not gone forever — different from permanently deleting it — and be able to look at the archived ones on their own.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Archive (reversible, separate view, distinct from delete) absent from baseline; client requested it and articulated the archive-vs-delete distinction — corrective/extend.

decisions.evidence: Tag autocomplete never appears in any presentation; R4 tasks 'Tags and favorites: 7' with no autocomplete; R5 client describes tagging ('tag them (and equivalent tags don't duplicate)') with no autocomplete mention.
decisions.note: Task/implementation stage. Reference requires existing-tag autocomplete on entry; enumerated scope shows basic tag entry only. Client approved (R2) and accepted (R5) without expressing this expectation — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No presentation mentions #tag search syntax; R4 'Search, filtering, and sorting: 6' tasks (basic); R5 client: 'search (case-insensitive), filtering, and sorting all return what I'd expect' — no #tag syntax.
decisions.note: Specification/task stage. Reference REF-BM-14 (#tag search) absent from the enumerated basic-search scope; client never expressed it — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: No presentation mentions AND/OR/NOT boolean operators or parenthesised groups; only 6 search/filter/sort tasks (R4); R5 client confirms only basic search behaviour.
decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-15 (boolean/parenthesised search with literal-operator quoting) absent from scope; passed without client expression — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Quoted-phrase exact-match search never mentioned in any round; R4 basic search category; R5 client acceptance lists only case-insensitive search/filter/sort.
decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-16 (quoted-phrase exact match) absent; client did not express it — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Bulk multi-select actions and 'apply to whole filtered collection' appear in no presentation; R4 60-task breakdown has no bulk-action category; R5 delivered-feature enumeration omits bulk actions.
decisions.note: Task/implementation stage. Reference REF-BM-20/21 (multi-select bulk actions, apply-to-filtered-collection) absent from the exhaustive scope; client never raised — unexpressed.

decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-23 (markdown note authored and rendered) absent from all enumerations; client did not express it — unexpressed.

decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-24 (single-file HTML snapshot, PDF stored for PDF urls) absent; passed without client expression — unexpressed.

decisions.note: Reference REF-BM-29 (bundles as saved filters) absent; client did not express it — unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'covers saving...'; R5 'persistent saving'; R5 client 'Saving a link pulls in the page's title automatically'.
decisions.note: Conforming presented decision: save a bookmark by url.

decisions.evidence: R1/R5 maker list 'editing'; R5 client offered edit of existing on duplicate.
decisions.note: Conforming: edit bookmark url/title/description/tags.

decisions.evidence: R2 maker 'with manual and visual fallbacks'; editing present; R5 client 'falls back gracefully when details are missing'.
decisions.note: Conforming enough: user can edit/override auto-collected title/description (manual fallbacks).

decisions.evidence: R1/R5 maker 'deleting'/'permanent deletion'; R5 client 'permanent delete removes it for good'.
decisions.note: Conforming: delete a bookmark permanently.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'duplicate detection'; R5 maker 'duplicate warnings'; R5 client 'saving the same link again warns me and offers to edit the existing one'.
decisions.note: Conforming: re-saving an existing url guides to editing the existing bookmark.

decisions.evidence: R1 client wanted list 'easy to skim'; R5 maker 'responsive desktop/mobile layouts', metadata for skimming.
decisions.note: Conforming: readability-first list exposing title/description/tags/favicon.

decisions.evidence: R1/R5 maker 'tags'; R5 client 'tag them (and equivalent tags don't duplicate)'.
decisions.note: Conforming: assign one or more tags.

decisions.evidence: R1/R5 maker 'filtering'; R5 client filtering 'return what I'd expect'.
decisions.note: Conforming: filter to a specific tag's bookmarks.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'searching'; R2 maker 'Search... now include descriptions'; R5 client search works. (Search-over-note is moot as notes are absent, folded into REF-BM-23.)
decisions.note: Conforming for available fields: full-text search over title/description/url.

decisions.note: Conforming: case-insensitive search, confirmed present at implementation review.

decisions.evidence: R1/R5 maker 'sorting'; R5 client sorting 'return what I'd expect'.
decisions.note: Conforming: sort the list by a sort key.

decisions.evidence: List/navigation implied by readability-first list and live-app use (R5 client used the app directly); no contrary evidence.
decisions.note: Treated as conforming: selecting a list item navigates to the original url (standard, no divergence evidence).
